course.title: Elements of Civil Engineering Structures
course.department: Department of Urban and Regional Planning

content.value: Calculate the earthquake load at each floor level for an Eight storied RCC school building located at Khulna. The seismic dead load for the first four storey is 3000 KN/Floor, for $4 ^ { \mathfrak { n } }$ and $5 ^ { \mathfrak { t h } }$ storey 2600 KN/Floor and 2200 KN/Floor for all other stories. Consider the height of each floor as 5m.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2019
